# biznetgio_neolite_pro_change_package_options (Data Source)

Opsi change-package (target package & harga) untuk akun NEO Lite Pro. Response endpoint undocumented, jadi di-export mentah sebagai `raw` JSON.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ganti <account_id> dengan account id VM NEO Lite Pro.
data "biznetgio_neolite_pro_change_package_options" "this" {
  account_id = 12345
}

output "options_raw" {
  value = data.biznetgio_neolite_pro_change_package_options.this.raw
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) Account id VM NEO Lite Pro.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source id statis.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response opsi change-package.
